Example of a diagnostic imaging prescription.
Inputs and values used in this example: - Patient: Henry Dutronc, male, 41 years old - Indication: progressive shortness of breath, orthopnea, dry cough and suspected pulmonary edema - Selected examination: chest X-ray - Procedure code (SNOMED): 399208008 - Initially predefined examination: chest CT with IV contrast - Clinical context from Excel: hypertension for 5 years, non-smoker, no documented cardiac disease or known allergies; symptoms progressing over 24-48 hours, oxygen saturation approximately 88%, blood pressure 160/100 mmHg and bilateral basal crackles - Final examination rationale from Excel: rapid initial assessment and confirmation
Fictitious completions (not specified in Excel): date of birth 1985-04-12, PSS identifier PSS-RAD-001, prescription and validity dates, requester, ambulatory track and routine priority; no implants, diabetes, metallic debris or renal dysfunction and no other safety concern. Clinical context is represented by encrypted placeholders in patientCondition.text and note.text; date of birth and sex at birth remain encrypted. Placeholders are illustrative, not real encrypted patient data. Procedure coding follows Exam List processed.xlsx.
